# Microsoft XDR telemetry readiness - KQL only
Standalone Defender workbook: most sections use Sentinel Logs; **Missing Defender for Identity Sensor** and **antivirus mode panels** query **Advanced hunting directly**, using the working provider settings from your exported workbook. No collector, custom tables, report imports, app registration, or Exchange PowerShell.

Select the Sentinel workspace connected to your XDR tenant. **All sections display together automatically**, each with its own lookback control defaulting to seven days. Changing a section's lookback affects only that section's charts and lists. The top availability lookback affects only the native-event availability panel.

Enable the required event streams in the Defender XDR connector; connecting incidents/alerts alone is insufficient. Results are limited to each section's selected time window, not a complete tenant inventory. No overall automation-readiness score is claimed.

content.title: Defender data received by Sentinel - event counts and latest activity
content.query:
let Required = datatable(TableName:string)["DeviceInfo", "IdentityDirectoryEvents"];
let Observed =
union isfuzzy=true
    (datatable(TableName:string, TimeGenerated:datetime)[]),
    (DeviceInfo | project TableName="DeviceInfo", TimeGenerated),
    (IdentityDirectoryEvents | project TableName="IdentityDirectoryEvents", TimeGenerated)
| summarize EventRows=count(), LatestEvent=max(TimeGenerated) by TableName;
Required
| join kind=leftouter Observed on TableName
| extend EventRows=coalesce(EventRows, long(0))
| extend EvidenceState=case(EventRows == 0,
    "NO EVIDENCE - table missing/empty in window; check event stream and query warnings",
    LatestEvent < ago(24h), "STALE - latest event is over 24 hours old", "Events present")
| project TableName, EventRows, LatestEvent, EvidenceState

## Endpoint coverage
Each device uses its latest event **within the selected window**. Eligible-not-onboarded devices are actionable coverage evidence, but a zero count does not prove every tenant device was discovered. Unknown and unsupported onboarding states remain visible. Merged device IDs and transient assets are not reconciled with an authoritative inventory.

### Devices needing review for Automatic Attack Disruption
**Advanced hunting; uses the Endpoint coverage lookback.** Your supplied query checks onboarding, Active sensor health and selected OS/build rules, and lists records it labels **AttackDisruptionCapable = No**, with the first matching failure reason.

**"No" here is not a definitive unsupported-device verdict.** Linux and macOS are included for manual verification, not confirmed unsupported. The OS rules are exactly those in the supplied query; other OS releases are not automatically recognized as supported. Linux distribution guesses from device names are hints, not verified OS inventory.

This is a prerequisite-screening list, not a full eligibility assessment: it does not verify all current product requirements, licensing, device-group settings, exclusions or action-specific prerequisites. Devices absent from the list are not certified capable. Latest records use ingestion_time() as supplied; LastReported shows the device Timestamp.

content.title: Devices failing Attack Disruption checks or requiring manual verification
content.query:
{"__advancedHuntingSettings":true,"query":"let LatestDeviceInfo =
    DeviceInfo
    | extend IngestionTime = ingestion_time()
    | where isnotempty(OSPlatform)
    | summarize arg_max(IngestionTime, *) by DeviceId;
LatestDeviceInfo
| extend
    IsWindows10 = OSPlatform =~ "Windows10",
    IsWindows11 = OSPlatform =~ "Windows11",
    IsServer2019 = OSPlatform =~ "WindowsServer2019",
    IsServer2022 = OSPlatform =~ "WindowsServer2022",
    IsLinux = OSPlatform =~ "Linux",
    IsMacOS = OSPlatform contains "macOS" or OSPlatform contains "Mac"
| extend LinuxDistribution = case(
    OSPlatform !~ "Linux", "Not applicable",
    isnotempty(OSDistribution), OSDistribution,
    DeviceName contains "ubuntu", "Ubuntu",
    DeviceName contains "kali", "Kali Linux",
    DeviceName contains "rhel", "Red Hat Enterprise Linux",
    DeviceName contains "redhat", "Red Hat Enterprise Linux",
    DeviceName contains "centos", "CentOS",
    DeviceName contains "debian", "Debian",
    DeviceName contains "sles", "SUSE Linux Enterprise Server",
    DeviceName contains "suse", "SUSE Linux Enterprise Server",
    DeviceName contains "oracle", "Oracle Linux",
    DeviceName contains "amazon", "Amazon Linux",
    DeviceName contains "fedora", "Fedora",
    "Unknown"
)
| extend OnboardingCheck = iff(
    OnboardingStatus =~ "Onboarded",
    "PASS",
    "FAIL"
)
| extend SensorHealthCheck = iff(
    SensorHealthState =~ "Active",
    "PASS",
    "FAIL"
)
| extend OSCheck = case(
    IsWindows10 and OSBuild >= 15063, "PASS",
    IsWindows11, "PASS",
    IsServer2019 and OSVersion =~ "10.0" and OSBuild >= 17763, "PASS",
    IsServer2022 and OSVersion =~ "10.0" and OSBuild >= 20348, "PASS",
    IsLinux, "MANUAL VERIFY",
    IsMacOS, "MANUAL VERIFY",
    "FAIL"
)
| extend AttackDisruptionCapable = iff(
    OnboardingCheck == "PASS"
        and SensorHealthCheck == "PASS"
        and OSCheck == "PASS",
    "Yes",
    "No"
)
| extend FailureReason = case(
    OnboardingCheck == "FAIL",
        "MDE not onboarded",
    SensorHealthCheck == "FAIL",
        "MDE sensor not active",
    IsServer2019 and OSVersion !~ "10.0",
        "Windows Server 2019 OSVersion is not 10.0",
    IsServer2019 and OSBuild < 17763,
        "Windows Server 2019 OSBuild is below 17763",
    IsServer2022 and OSVersion !~ "10.0",
        "Windows Server 2022 OSVersion is not 10.0",
    IsServer2022 and OSBuild < 20348,
        "Windows Server 2022 OSBuild is below 20348",
    IsWindows10 and OSBuild < 15063,
        "Windows 10 OSBuild is below 15063",
    IsLinux and LinuxDistribution == "Unknown",
        "Linux distribution could not be identified",
    IsLinux,
        strcat("Linux support requires verification: ", LinuxDistribution, " ", OSVersion),
    IsMacOS,
        "macOS support requires verification",
    "OS does not meet requirement"
)
| where AttackDisruptionCapable == "No"
| where isnotempty(DeviceName)
| project
    DeviceName,
    AttackDisruptionCapable,
    FailureReason,
    OSPlatform,
    OSDistribution,
    OSVersion,
    OSBuild,
    OSArchitecture,
    OnboardingStatus,
    OnboardingCheck,
    SensorHealthState,
    SensorHealthCheck,
    MachineGroup,
    MDEClientVersion = ClientVersion,
    LastReported = Timestamp
| order by DeviceName asc","selectedWorkspaceIds":["e34d562e-ef12-4c4e-9bc0-7c6ae357c015"]}

### MDE endpoints - Microsoft Defender Antivirus mode
**Active mode:** Microsoft Defender Antivirus is the primary antivirus. It provides real-time scanning and threat blocking/remediation according to the device's configured protection settings.

**Passive mode:** Microsoft Defender Antivirus is not the primary antivirus. It can retain scanning/reporting capabilities, but does not provide the normal active-mode real-time blocking and remediation. Passive mode can be appropriate when another supported antivirus product is installed, healthy and providing real-time protection.

**Risk if no other antivirus is protecting the device:** passive mode can leave a gap in real-time malware prevention, increasing exposure to malicious files, ransomware and other threats. An active MDE sensor does **not** mean Defender Antivirus is active. MDE endpoint detection and response can still operate; EDR in block mode can provide post-breach remediation when configured, but is not a replacement for primary antivirus protection.

**Action:** for every passive device, confirm a primary antivirus is actually installed, running, current and protecting the device. If none is present, investigate promptly and restore an approved active antivirus configuration. Coordinate policy changes to avoid conflicts with an existing antivirus. **This workbook does not determine whether another antivirus is installed or healthy**, so a passive result alone does not establish an unprotected device.

**Reading this chart:** Advanced hunting reports Active = AvMode 0 and Passive = AvMode 1. EDR in block mode (4), Disabled/LPS (2), Other (3), unknown and missing data remain separate. These are antivirus modes, not MDE sensor Active/Inactive states. Review the AV observation timestamp and freshness before treating an old result as current.

Uses latest DeviceTvmInfoGathering per device, joined by DeviceId to the latest onboarded DeviceInfo cohort. Missing TVM access/licensing surfaces an error, not an empty pass. All queries use this section's lookback and the Advanced hunting workspace from your export; the top Logs workspace picker does not change that hunting scope.

## Windows Server MDE sensor health
The chart and lists use the same latest DeviceInfo record per device in the selected window. **Active** and **Inactive** refer to the reported MDE sensor-health state, not Defender Antivirus active/passive mode. Impaired communications, no sensor data and not-onboarded servers are kept separate rather than mislabeled inactive.

The lists flag observations older than 24 hours; an old "Active" record is not proof that the device is active now. Devices absent from the entire selected window are not counted. Change **Event lookback** to 30 days to investigate older observations.

content.json:
## Defender Antivirus and MDE versions
**Advanced hunting data source.** This section shows the different Defender components, not just the MDE client:

- **MDE client/sensor version:** the endpoint detection and response client (DeviceInfo.ClientVersion).
- **Defender Antivirus engine version:** the malware-scanning engine (AvEngineVersion).
- **Defender Antivirus platform version:** the antivirus platform/components (AvPlatformVersion).
- **Security intelligence/signature version:** the threat-detection definitions (AvSignatureVersion).

There is no separate "MDE engine version" in these fields: the antivirus engine and MDE client are different components. The complete device list shows all four versions side by side. Summary tables group each component by OS and architecture. Unknown data is kept visible; availability varies by platform, product access and telemetry.

Latest device and antivirus observations are selected independently within this section's lookback and joined by DeviceId. Review timestamps and freshness; old or different version strings alone do not establish that a device is outdated. No lexical version maximum or unsupported latest-release baseline is used.

content.json:
## Tier-0 Active Directory role evidence
Focus: **Domain Controllers, AD FS, AD CS and Entra ID Connect**. Reported roles (when the streamed DeviceInfo schema includes DeviceRoles) and manual/dynamic/registry tags now identify candidates even without a recent process or registry event. **Role and tag evidence are labeled separately**; an assigned tag is not proof of an installed role.

Enable **DeviceProcessEvents** and **DeviceRegistryEvents** for additional service/process evidence. These sources identify **candidate systems with observed role/service evidence**, not an authoritative current installed-role inventory.

Service registry creations/value writes identify NTDS, adfssrv, CertSvc and ADSync. Process observations identify AD FS service hosts, certsrv.exe and miiserver.exe under the Microsoft Azure AD Sync path. Initiating-process evidence is included for long-running services. **lsass.exe alone is not used to identify domain controllers.**

An installed service may emit no relevant event during this window; removed services, leftover keys or renamed/spoofed executables can also affect results. Entra Cloud Sync and generic MIM synchronization engines are not classified as Entra ID Connect. Validate candidates against your authoritative inventory; zero rows never proves there are no Tier-0 assets. Chart counts are per role, so a multi-role device appears in multiple categories.

content.title: Tier-0 evidence stream availability
content.query:
let Required=datatable(TableName:string)["DeviceInfo", "DeviceProcessEvents", "DeviceRegistryEvents"];
let Observed=
union isfuzzy=true
    (datatable(TableName:string,TimeGenerated:datetime)[]),
    (DeviceInfo | project TableName="DeviceInfo",TimeGenerated),
    (DeviceProcessEvents | project TableName="DeviceProcessEvents",TimeGenerated),
    (DeviceRegistryEvents | project TableName="DeviceRegistryEvents",TimeGenerated)
| summarize Events=count(),LatestEvent=max(TimeGenerated) by TableName;
Required | join kind=leftouter Observed on TableName
| extend Events=coalesce(Events,long(0))
| extend EvidenceState=iff(Events == 0,
    "NO EVIDENCE - missing/empty stream; review warnings and connector", "Events present")
| project TableName,Events,LatestEvent,EvidenceState

content.title: Tier-0 reported roles and matching tags - inventory evidence
content.query:
let Devices = DeviceInfo
| where isnotempty(DeviceId)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId;
Devices
| extend LabelSources=pack_array(
    pack("Source", "DeviceInfo.DeviceRoles", "Labels", tostring(column_ifexists("DeviceRoles", ""))),
    pack("Source", "DeviceInfo.DeviceManualTags", "Labels", tostring(DeviceManualTags)),
    pack("Source", "DeviceInfo.DeviceDynamicTags", "Labels", tostring(DeviceDynamicTags)),
    pack("Source", "DeviceInfo.RegistryDeviceTag", "Labels", tostring(RegistryDeviceTag)))
| mv-expand LabelSources
| extend RawLabels=tostring(LabelSources.Labels), EvidenceSource=tostring(LabelSources.Source)
| extend ParsedLabels=parse_json(RawLabels)
| extend Labels=case(gettype(ParsedLabels) == "dictionary", bag_keys(ParsedLabels),
    gettype(ParsedLabels) == "array", ParsedLabels,
    split(replace_string(RawLabels, ";", ","), ","))
| mv-expand Labels
| extend RoleDetails=iff(gettype(ParsedLabels) == "dictionary", ParsedLabels[tostring(Labels)], dynamic(null))
| extend OriginalLabel=iff(isnotempty(tostring(RoleDetails.Name)),tostring(RoleDetails.Name),tostring(Labels))
| extend NormalizedLabel=replace_regex(tolower(OriginalLabel), @"[^a-z0-9]", "")
| extend Role=case(
    NormalizedLabel in ("domaincontroller", "domaincontrollers"), "Domain Controller",
    NormalizedLabel in ("adfs", "activedirectoryfederationservices"), "AD FS",
    NormalizedLabel in ("adcs", "activedirectorycertificateservices", "certificateauthority", "certificationauthority"), "AD CS",
    NormalizedLabel in ("entraidconnect", "entraconnect", "azureadconnect", "aadconnect",
        "entraconnectserver","azureadconnectserver"), "Entra ID Connect",
    "")
| where isnotempty(Role)
| project DeviceId, EvidenceDeviceName=DeviceName, Role, EvidenceTime=TimeGenerated,
    EvidenceSource, Signal=strcat(OriginalLabel,
        iff(isnotnull(RoleDetails),strcat(" | ",tostring(RoleDetails)),""))
| project Role, DeviceName=EvidenceDeviceName, DeviceId, EvidenceSource, Label=Signal, LastDeviceInfo=EvidenceTime
| order by Role asc, DeviceName asc

content.title: Tier-0 candidate devices by observed role
content.query:
let Devices = DeviceInfo
| where isnotempty(DeviceId)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId;
let ClassifiedDevices = Devices
| extend ReportedCriticality=tostring(column_ifexists("CriticalityLevel", "")),
    ReportedDeviceValue=tostring(column_ifexists("DeviceValue", "")),
    ReportedIsSensitive=tobool(column_ifexists("IsSensitive", "")),
    TagSources=pack_array(
        pack("Source","DeviceManualTags","Labels",tostring(DeviceManualTags)),
        pack("Source","DeviceDynamicTags","Labels",tostring(DeviceDynamicTags)),
        pack("Source","RegistryDeviceTag","Labels",tostring(RegistryDeviceTag)))
| mv-apply TagSource=TagSources on (
    extend RawTags=tostring(TagSource.Labels)
    | extend ParsedTags=parse_json(RawTags)
    | extend Tags=iff(gettype(ParsedTags) == "array", ParsedTags,
        split(replace_string(RawTags,";",","),","))
    | mv-expand Tags
    | extend TagLabel=tolower(trim(@"\s+",tostring(Tags)))
    | summarize SensitiveTagSources=make_set_if(tostring(TagSource.Source),TagLabel == "sensitive",3),
        CriticalTagSources=make_set_if(tostring(TagSource.Source),TagLabel == "critical",3)
)
| extend HasSensitiveTag=array_length(SensitiveTagSources) > 0,
    HasCriticalTag=array_length(CriticalTagSources) > 0,
    CriticalityLabel=iff(isempty(ReportedCriticality),"Unknown / not streamed",ReportedCriticality),
    VeryHighCriticality=replace_regex(tolower(ReportedCriticality), @"[^a-z0-9]", "") == "veryhigh",
    VeryHighDeviceValue=replace_regex(tolower(ReportedDeviceValue), @"[^a-z0-9]", "") == "veryhigh",
    VeryHighAssetValue=replace_regex(tolower(AssetValue), @"[^a-z0-9]", "") == "veryhigh"
| extend SensitivityEvidence=case(ReportedIsSensitive == true, "Reported IsSensitive=true",
    HasSensitiveTag, "Sensitive tag observed",
    ReportedIsSensitive == false, "Reported IsSensitive=false", "Unknown / not streamed")
| extend IsPriorityEvidence=HasCriticalTag or VeryHighCriticality or VeryHighDeviceValue or VeryHighAssetValue
    or ReportedIsSensitive == true or HasSensitiveTag
| extend InclusionReason=strcat(
    iff(HasCriticalTag,"Critical tag; ",""),
    iff(VeryHighCriticality,"Very High criticality; ",""),
    iff(VeryHighDeviceValue,"Very High DeviceValue; ",""),
    iff(VeryHighAssetValue,"Very High AssetValue; ",""),
    iff(ReportedIsSensitive == true,"Reported sensitive; ",""),
    iff(HasSensitiveTag,"Sensitive tag; ",""));
let InventoryRoleEvidence = Devices
| extend LabelSources=pack_array(
    pack("Source", "DeviceInfo.DeviceRoles", "Labels", tostring(column_ifexists("DeviceRoles", ""))),
    pack("Source", "DeviceInfo.DeviceManualTags", "Labels", tostring(DeviceManualTags)),
    pack("Source", "DeviceInfo.DeviceDynamicTags", "Labels", tostring(DeviceDynamicTags)),
    pack("Source", "DeviceInfo.RegistryDeviceTag", "Labels", tostring(RegistryDeviceTag)))
| mv-expand LabelSources
| extend RawLabels=tostring(LabelSources.Labels), EvidenceSource=tostring(LabelSources.Source)
| extend ParsedLabels=parse_json(RawLabels)
| extend Labels=case(gettype(ParsedLabels) == "dictionary", bag_keys(ParsedLabels),
    gettype(ParsedLabels) == "array", ParsedLabels,
    split(replace_string(RawLabels, ";", ","), ","))
| mv-expand Labels
| extend RoleDetails=iff(gettype(ParsedLabels) == "dictionary", ParsedLabels[tostring(Labels)], dynamic(null))
| extend OriginalLabel=iff(isnotempty(tostring(RoleDetails.Name)),tostring(RoleDetails.Name),tostring(Labels))
| extend NormalizedLabel=replace_regex(tolower(OriginalLabel), @"[^a-z0-9]", "")
| extend Role=case(
    NormalizedLabel in ("domaincontroller", "domaincontrollers"), "Domain Controller",
    NormalizedLabel in ("adfs", "activedirectoryfederationservices"), "AD FS",
    NormalizedLabel in ("adcs", "activedirectorycertificateservices", "certificateauthority", "certificationauthority"), "AD CS",
    NormalizedLabel in ("entraidconnect", "entraconnect", "azureadconnect", "aadconnect",
        "entraconnectserver","azureadconnectserver"), "Entra ID Connect",
    "")
| where isnotempty(Role)
| project DeviceId, EvidenceDeviceName=DeviceName, Role, EvidenceTime=TimeGenerated,
    EvidenceSource, Signal=strcat(OriginalLabel,
        iff(isnotnull(RoleDetails),strcat(" | ",tostring(RoleDetails)),""));
let ProcessEvidence =
union isfuzzy=true
    (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime,DeviceId:string,DeviceName:string,FileName:string,FolderPath:string,InitiatingProcessFileName:string,InitiatingProcessFolderPath:string)[]),
    DeviceProcessEvents
| where isnotempty(DeviceId)
| extend ObservedProcesses=pack_array(
    pack("Name", FileName, "Path", FolderPath),
    pack("Name", InitiatingProcessFileName, "Path", InitiatingProcessFolderPath))
| mv-expand ObservedProcesses
| extend ProcessName=tolower(tostring(ObservedProcesses.Name)),
    ProcessPath=tolower(tostring(ObservedProcesses.Path))
| extend Role=case(
    ProcessName == "microsoft.identityserver.servicehost.exe" or ProcessName == "microsoft.identityserver.service.exe", "AD FS",
    ProcessName == "certsrv.exe", "AD CS",
    ProcessName == "miiserver.exe" and ProcessPath contains @"\microsoft azure ad sync\", "Entra ID Connect",
    "")
| where isnotempty(Role)
| project DeviceId, EvidenceDeviceName=DeviceName, Role, EvidenceTime=TimeGenerated,
    EvidenceSource="DeviceProcessEvents", Signal=strcat(ProcessName, " | ", ProcessPath);
let RegistryEvidence =
union isfuzzy=true
    (datatable(TimeGenerated:datetime,DeviceId:string,DeviceName:string,ActionType:string,RegistryKey:string,RegistryValueName:string)[]),
    DeviceRegistryEvents
| where isnotempty(DeviceId) and ActionType in~ ("RegistryKeyCreated", "RegistryValueSet")
| extend ServiceName=tolower(extract(@"(?i)\\SYSTEM\\(?:CurrentControlSet|ControlSet[0-9]+)\\Services\\(NTDS|adfssrv|CertSvc|ADSync)(?:\\|$)", 1, RegistryKey))
| extend Role=case(ServiceName == "ntds", "Domain Controller", ServiceName == "adfssrv", "AD FS",
    ServiceName == "certsvc", "AD CS", ServiceName == "adsync", "Entra ID Connect", "")

## Identity telemetry
Directory-event activity is not a sensor heartbeat. Silence may mean a quiet system, a connector gap or sensor issues; it does **not** prove a sensor is offline. Results identify systems observed in this window. Never-reporting systems are absent.

For role-based missing-MDI candidates, use the dedicated **Missing Defender for Identity Sensor** section below.

content.title: Identity directory event activity
content.query:
IdentityDirectoryEvents
| summarize EventCount=count(), LatestEvent=max(TimeGenerated) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

content.title: Systems with identity event silence over three hours
content.query:
IdentityDirectoryEvents
| where isnotempty(DeviceName)
| summarize LastIdentityEvent=max(TimeGenerated), ObservedEvents=count() by NormalizedName=tolower(DeviceName)
| where LastIdentityEvent < ago(3h)
| extend HoursSinceIdentityEvent=round(datetime_diff("minute", now(), LastIdentityEvent) / 60.0, 1)
| project DeviceName=NormalizedName, LastIdentityEvent, HoursSinceIdentityEvent, ObservedEvents
| order by HoursSinceIdentityEvent desc
